_about: RetroBake theme styles. One fixed prompt template + fixed seed per style so wallpapers and icons in a set match. Original art only: no franchise characters, logos or level look-alikes.
wallpaper_template: {scene}. Vibrant 16-bit pixel art video game background, wide panoramic landscape, ultra detailed, crisp clean hard-edged pixels, bright saturated colors, high contrast, strong depth with layered parallax, empty center-left area for menu text, no text, no letters, no logos, no people, no characters, no UI
icon_template: Six separate video game menu icons arranged in a neat 3 by 2 grid with wide gaps, each icon centered in its own cell: {icons}. Style: {icon_style}. Thick dark outline, glossy, bold, same palette and lighting on all six, each on a flat solid pure magenta #FF00FF background, no text, no letters, no shadows on the background
icon_subjects: a cute original home console with a cartridge
